name: github-sites-gallery
description: Preview gallery of sites deployed from and linked to public and private user and org repositories.
author: profile-icons

scripts.prepare:data: tsx scripts/sites.ts && tsx scripts/translate.ts && tsx scripts/capture.ts
scripts.dev:data: npm run prepare:data && npm run dev
scripts.build:data: npm run prepare:data && npm run build
scripts.verify: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && biome check .&& cargo fmt --manifest-path scripts/translator/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path scripts/translator/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify:fix: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && biome check --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path scripts/translator/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path scripts/translator/Cargo.toml --all-targets --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged -- -D warnings
